why: TRA is modernising core systems, automating processes toward 100%, and integrating internal/external systems (90→300). Vendors, integrators and developers are directly in demand.
Analytics-driven tax eligibility, AI/ML risk & fraud models (2→10), a unified enterprise data platform and data-governance framework.
A KPI targets cyber-threat reduction (7%→60%) and data-governance breach control as systems and data volumes grow.
Focus on the informal economy, third-party data, audits, dispute reduction and voluntary compliance widens demand for advisers and compliance tech.
Clearance time targeted to halve (8→4 days), an AEO programme, and border-surveillance upgrades favour logistics and trade-facilitation providers.
ITA is expanding programmes, e-learning (Moodle/LMS), certification and public training; large internal reskilling is planned.
An ITA Academic Building and Misugusugu campus, office and staff-housing construction, renovations and camera/security systems are planned.
Integration of digital payment channels and taxing non-resident digital services create fintech and data-sharing opportunities.
Research proposals, EOIs/RFPs, external consultancies and policy briefs are explicitly targeted to grow.
ESG is being institutionalised (0→80% integration) alongside change management and enterprise risk — a new advisory market.
Staff wellness, HIV/AIDS and NCD screening and support programmes are funded across the workforce.
Taxpayer education, communication channels and public reporting on performance expand steadily.
